Add the $42.8 billion of marketable equity securities in current assets and NVIDIA is carrying roughly $94 billion of equity positions in other companies, many of them its own customers. Every one of these numbers is asserted against the filed balance sheet, so total assets ($320.3 billion) and total liabilities ($91.3 billion) tie out to the dollar. ... Six months into fiscal 2027, NVIDIA has already earned within about $2 billion of what it earned in all of fiscal 2026, and its first-half revenue exceeds fiscal 2025's full year by more than a third.

Nvidia reported GAAP net income of $59.7bn for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, ended 26 July 2026, up 126% from $26.4bn a year earlier.

GAAP diluted earnings per share rose 128% to $2.46 from $1.08. Revenue reached $96.2bn, up 106% from $46.7bn in the corresponding quarter of fiscal 2026. GAAP operating income increased 124% to $63.73bn from $28.44bn.
